name: Ball rolls past annotated paper documents
looks: The same ball rolls steadily along a ruled baseline, passing a scatter of paper-like documents above and below the line: a submitted bid summary, a drawing sheet, a sticky note rule, a pricing sheet, each labelled in a casual handwritten script with a small arrow pointing at it.
build: bounce-path-draw continues the ball's progressive line reveal along the baseline at a steady roll instead of a bounce; each document pops in as the ball passes beneath it, with annotated-diagram-overlay's label-and-arrow mechanic naming it, one label live at a time.
sound: A steady soft roll tone under the ball, a light tick as each document and its label pops in.
prompt: Show a process as a single continuous roll: a marker travels steadily along a baseline past a handful of real, labelled documents representing the steps of the old workflow, one hand-drawn label naming each as the marker passes it.
